$comment: Registry of the agents in ./agents, read by scripts/agents.mjs and by the main agent (see CLAUDE.md). Paths are relative to this folder, except outputs.dir, which is relative to the workspace; outputs.env names the variable that moves an agent's results elsewhere (VAR, or VAR/subfolder, resolved from the agent's folder).

workspace.$comment: Everything the agents make, and the product they work for, lives in the workspace: product/, products/, briefs/, out/<agent>/, sites/, dev/, references/<agent>/. The kit's .gitignore leaves it out; it is its own (private) git repository. Location: $SUPERPRODUCT_WORKSPACE (absolute, or relative to this folder), else workspace/, which may be a symlink. Keys stay in each agent's .env.

product.$comment: Every agent works for the product described in the product folder: brand (design tokens, logo, fonts), voice, facts, offers. Agents find it with --product <dir|id|none> (an id means workspace/products/<id>), else $PRODUCT_DIR, else workspace/product (dev only for repos listed in product.json → repos). Spec: templates/product/README.md (copied into the product folder by init); loader: lib/product.mjs; per-agent settings: product.json → agents.<id>.

agents.title: LinkedIn carousel, consulting style
agents.summary: Brief → 4-6 slide LinkedIn document carousel in the top-consulting-firm look (hero numbers, frosted-glass cover over a 3D render) in the product's brand (electric blue without a product folder). HTML slides + OpenAI imagery → PNGs, swipeable PDF, caption.

agents.title: Collage social post (single post or carousel)
agents.summary: Brief → editorial collage posts (1080×1350): cutouts, duotones, torn paper, bold type; the product's 'brand' palette, fonts and masthead (or nine stock palettes), eight layouts. GPT Image ingredients, public-domain Wikimedia photos for real people. PNGs, HTML, caption, zip.

agents.title: PDF deck (16:9) or A4 report, McKinsey-style available
agents.summary: Brief + data files (CSV/XLSX/JSON/MD/PDF) → storyline with action titles, charts/diagrams/tables/KPIs from data, layout-QA'd pages → searchable PDF, page PNGs, exhibits, speaker notes. Five themes, each in the product's colours, fonts and logo; the product's house theme by default.

agents.title: Explainer video (MP4), HyperFrames motion graphics
agents.summary: Brief (+ images, clips, notes) → 30–90 s explainer video in the product's brand that teaches a newcomer (TED-Ed-style: one question, at most three main points, plain words, a recap). Storyboard first: a run stops at a storyboard for review (storyboard.md + the sketch sheet storyboard.jpg); --revise changes it, --approve builds the video (--no-storyboard: one go). HyperFrames' explainer workflow with every HyperFrames skill bundled (story, a frame preset remixed onto the brand, one frame-worker per frame, lint/check, contact sheet, local render). Default style editorial: cinematic B&W halftone cut-outs on brand-colour fields, type behind the subject, spotlight and connector callouts, camera push with parallax, film grain; its look (colour-field, paper-data, documentary, duotone) picked from the brand or set with --look. --style vox-collage for a Vox-style paper collage. 4:5 portrait by default (9:16, 1:1, 16:9 on request); silent with on-screen text; pictures generated in the product's illustration style (OpenAI) when OPENAI_API_KEY is set; narration with word-timed captions (--voice), a composed music bed (--music auto|<mood>) and sound effects (--sfx) with ElevenLabs. MP4, contact sheet, caption, alt text.

agents.title: Landing page (Next.js + Tailwind, static export)
agents.summary: Brief (+ assets) → a tested landing page in the product's brand (set_brand values, logos, actions, voice and facts from PRODUCT.md) on the Corporate Landing design system: planned sections, library + custom components, lint, build, interaction test, screenshots → static site in workspace/sites/<slug>/out.

agents.title: Developer for existing GitHub repos
agents.summary: Feature request → PRD → milestone plan → tested commits in a per-run Docker workspace → automated review → pushed branch + draft PR. First run per repo is a setup interview (stack detection, dev skills like Laravel Boost, workspace check). Gets the product's context only for repos listed in product.json → repos (or --product).
agents.example: npm run agent -- "Let customers export invoices as CSV" --project shop --relay
